title: Council Hall Turmoil
next_chapter_hook: Just when everyone thought the situation was settled, a manic killing intent flashed in the Second Elder's eyes—he intended to personally eliminate this worthless disciple who knew too many of his secrets.

text.content: When the third bell of morning rang, the doors of the Tianqing Sect Council Hall burst open. Morning light poured in like golden foil, stretching the shadows of the hundred-plus cultivators inside. In the corner, Chen Ji followed at the tail of the crowd with his head bowed, his gray servant's robe starkly shabby among the numerous ornate garments. No one noticed him—just as they had grown accustomed to over the past twelve years.

At the head seat, the Grand Elder sat with dignified composure, flanked by eight elders on either side. The Second Elder occupied the third seat, today dressed in a sect ceremonial robe of ink-green embroidered with gold, his face as elegant as a jade crown, with three long whiskers beneath his chin swaying gently in the wind—a perfect image of celestial elegance. His gaze swept across the hall and finally landed on the gray-robed figure in the corner, a cold smile barely perceptible at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: Today's council has three important matters. First, the Three Sects Doctrinal Discussion in half a month; second, the assessment of newly promoted disciples; and third...

text.content: Before the Grand Elder could finish, an untimely voice suddenly echoed from the corner. Everyone turned to look—only to see that the gray-robed servant had slowly lifted his head—those eyes were terrifyingly calm, as if beneath a deep pool hid churning undercurrents. Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears: "Third, is Elder Chen Ping of the Second Elder present among those in council?"

Silence fell over the hall, so quiet a needle dropping could be heard. Everyone looked at each other in disbelief—a servant disciple, daring to publicly name and question an elder? Elder Chen Ping's smile froze on his face, then erupted into furious rage: "Insolence! How dare a servant run wild in the Council Hall? Someone, throw him out!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained unmoved, taking a jade slip from his sleeve and raising it high: "This disciple possesses the complete chain of evidence regarding my father Chen Xuan's murder twelve years ago. May I ask, Second Elder, do you dare engage in a public confrontation here, before the ancestors and fellow sect members?"

text.content: At these words, the entire hall erupted in chaos. The death of Chen Xuan twelve years ago remained a forbidden topic in the sect—some said he encountered an accident during outside training, others claimed he suffered a deviation in cultivation—but no one had ever dared publicly question it. And today, this acknowledgedtrash was attempting to challenge the Second Elder, who held significant power, by鸡蛋碰石头 in a public accusation?

dialogue.content: The Grand Elder's brow furrowed tightly, raising his hand to halt the law enforcement disciples about to advance: "Chen Ji, do you understand the crime of falsely accusing an elder?" His gaze was profound, as if examining something, "If the evidence is insufficient, you face capital punishment."

"This disciple is willing to stake his life as guarantee." Chen Ji stared directly at the Grand Elder, his voice steady without a trace offluctuation, "But if the evidence is conclusive, I implore the Grand Elder to uphold justice—restore my father's innocence, and return to the Tianqing Sect a clear and righteous sky."

choice.prompt: Elder Chen Pingsneered一声，率先发难：「一个杂役也敢血口喷人？我倒要看看你能拿出什么证据来！」Chen Ji该如何应对这第一波攻势？

choices.description: First display the records within the jade slip, from the Second Elder's private financial dealings with the Grand Elder to the procurement records of that year, presenting them one by one, using ironclad evidence to silence all doubts.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of the trump card
choices.visible_reward: Establish a momentum advantage, forcing the Second Elder into a passive position
choices.risk_hint: Exposing all evidence too early may give the other party points to refute

text.content: Chen Ji activated the jade slip, projecting image after image across the hall—twelve-year-old account books, mysterious transaction records, and a blurry figure infiltrating Chen Xuan's cave dwelling. "Everyone please observe—this is the sect material allocation record from three days before my father's death."

dialogue.content: Elder Chen Ping's expression changed drastically, but quickly regained composure,sneereding: "These are merely hearsay, who can prove it was my doing? Perhaps you forged these from somewhere to frame me!"

choices.text: Use verbal provocation to anger him
choices.description: Deliberately provoke the Second Elder with mockery, causing him to slip up or act out in rage, then seize the handle for a lethal strike after he's vulnerable.
choices.visible_reward: Let the Second Elder become disorganized and expose weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Provoking the elder may provoke on-the-spot retaliation

dialogue.content: "Second Elder, why must you be so agitated?" Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile appearing particularly glaring against the gray robe, "Could it be a guilty conscience? Speaking of which, Father trusted you greatly back then, even giving you a spare key to his cave dwelling's restriction token."

The Second Elder's face turned ashen, he abruptly slammed the table and rose: "You worthless wretch, don't dare slander me with such blood-stained words! Your father and I were as close as brothers—how could I possibly harm him?" The moment the words left his mouth, he realized his mistake, his expression flickering with uncertainty.

text.content: Just as the Second Elder's intimidation faltered, Chen Ji suddenly hurled the jade slip high into the air. His hands formed rapid incantation seals as he low shouted: "Tianji Record, manifest!" The jade slip burst into dazzling golden light, and a massive image gradually unfolded in the center of the hall—a familiar cave dwelling, the time unmistakably that blood-soaked night twelve years ago.

dialogue.content: In the image, Chen Xuan lay grievously wounded, a jet-black dagger piercing his chest. A shadowy figure emerged from the darkness, its features identical to the Second Elder—Chen Ping himself. He gazed down at the fallen Chen Xuan, murmuring: "Senior brother, forgive me. The Tianji Record chose you, not me... this fortune, you cannot bear."

text.content: The hall fell into absolute silence. Every gaze locked onto the Second Elder—some stunned, others furious, most simply disbelieving. That dignified Second Elder, the hypocrite who constantly claimed brotherhood with Chen Xuan, now stood ashen-faced, his body trembling slightly.

dialogue.content: "This... this is a fabrication!" the Second Elder howled hysterically. "The Tianji Record lost its fragment twelve years ago—how could a worthless wretch like you possess it? This must be some wicked technique to create false visions and deceive everyone!" He abruptly pointed at Chen Ji. "Elder, this scheming individual harbors sinister intentions and must be executed immediately!"

choice.prompt: The Second Elder, in a desperate attempt to save himself, accused Chen Ji of using wicked techniques to fabricate evidence. At this critical moment, how should Chen Ji completely crush his evasions?

choices.text: Reveal Mo Xiansheng's identity as testimony
choices.description: Have Mo Xiansheng appear in remnant soul form to testify personally, using his identity as Chen Xuan's master to morally and utterly devastate the Second Elder's evasions.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the existence of the Tianji Record Guardian
choices.visible_reward: Escalate the evidence to ironclad proof, leaving the Second Elder with no room for denial.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's exposure may attract attention from higher authorities

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and bit his fingertip, drawing a complex rune on the jade slip: "Master, please manifest." Brilliant golden light erupted as a translucent elderly figure emerged from the jade slip—Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit. After surveying the surroundings, his gaze settled on the Second Elder, and he sighed: "Chen Ping, when I passed the Tianji Record to Chen Xuan, you harbored murderous intent. Am I not correct?"

dialogue.content: The Second Elder's entire body shuddered, his voice cracking: "You... you're Chen Xuan's master? Weren't you supposed to have perished long ago? These... these are merely his one-sided account!" Yet his voice already trembled, his confidence utterly depleted.

choices.text: Logical reasoning pressing step by step
choices.description: Without Mo Xiansheng appearing, instead use a rigorous chain of logic to drive the Second Elder into a corner—from restriction tokens, to timelines, to motivational interests, each link tightly connected, leaving him speechless.
choices.visible_cost: The Second Elder may find logical loopholes to counterattack
choices.visible_reward: Display Chen Ji's supreme strategic wisdom, making everyone present sincerely convinced.
choices.risk_hint: If the logic contains flaws, the opponent might seize upon them

dialogue.content: "A fine 'one-sided account.'" Chen Ji coldly smirked. "Then I ask the Second Elder—regarding the restriction token for my father's cave dwelling, besides my father himself, only you possessed one. Who else could have entered the cave silently that night? Furthermore, when you reported my father's cause of death to the sect as 'encountering a demonic beast while out for training,' how do you explain the fact that this image clearly shows a blade piercing through the heart?"

The Second Elder's mouth gaped open, cold sweat beading on his forehead. The surrounding disciples and elders began whispering among themselves, their gazes shifting from suspicion to disgust and fury.

text.content: The Grand Elder slowly rose to his feet, his voice resonating like a temple bell: "Chen Ping, what else do you have to say?" The Second Elder's face turned deathly pale, his legs giving way as he collapsed onto the ground, his lips trembling but not a single word emerging. Twelve years of meticulous deception crumbled in an instant.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji retracted the jade slip, surveying the surroundings with a gaze so calm it held not a trace offluctuation: "Fellow disciples, today Chen Ji dares to expose this truth not for personal vendetta, but solely to vindicate my wrongfully accused father." He bowed slightly. "All matters hereafter shall be decided by the sect's public judgment."

text.content: At that moment, a fierce glint flashed through the Second Elder's eyes as he slumped on the ground. He suddenly lunged forward, a gleaming dagger materializing in his hand out of nowhere, thrusting directly toward Chen Ji's throat—"Die, you worthless wretch!!"

choice.prompt: The Second Elder, in a desperate last gambit, attempted public murder with a blade! Did Chen Ji have prior preparation, or was he in grave danger?

choices.text: Prepared in advance, calmly evade with ease
choices.description: Chen Ji had anticipated that the Second Elder would act desperately in his hour of need. As he sidestepped, he activated the residual Heavenly Secrets power within his body to shield his vital points, causing the assassination attempt to miss its mark.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a small amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Escape calmly from danger, displaying profound foresight
choices.risk_hint: Consuming Heavenly Fate may affect subsequent abilities

text.content: As if Chen Ji had long foreseen this, his body swayed slightly as he retreated three chi. The dagger barely grazed past his ear, tearing away a strip of cloth from his gray robe. Immediately, he struck back with a palm to the Second Elder's chest, sending this highly respected elder flying and crashing heavily in the center of the hall.

choices.description: Since the Second Elder once entered the room to commit murder using a forbidden talisman token, Chen Ji today shall let him taste the滋味 of being ambushed in the same manner—snatching the blade and restraining his vital points.
choices.visible_reward: Personally restraining an enemy brings greater satisfaction
choices.risk_hint: Close combat may expose one to enemy ambushes

text.content: In a flash of lightning, Chen Ji erupted into motion, his five fingers clamping down on the Second Elder's dagger-wielding wrist like iron tongs. A sharp crack rang out as the dagger fell to the ground, and the Second Elder screamed in agony. Chen Ji pressed him to the ground, his voice still calm: 'Twelve years ago, wasn't this how you held my father down?'

The hall erupted in an uproar. Law Enforcement Disciples swarmed forward, pressing the collapsed Second Elder firmly to the ground. The Grand Elder's face turned ashen with fury as he slammed his hand on the armrest: 'Chen Ping! How dare you commit violence in the Council Hall!' He surveyed his surroundings and spoke in a heavy tone: 'Today's matter has ironclad evidence. Effective immediately, Chen Ping shall be confined to the Demon Suppression Tower and transferred to the Sect's Criminal Hall for thorough investigation!'

As the Second Elder was dragged away, he was still screaming hysterically: 'This is a frame-up! This is a frame-up!! Chen Xuan's death had nothing to do with me!!' But no one believed him anymore. His former prestige, his former immortal demeanor, all turned to mockery before the irrefutable evidence.

After the commotion subsided, the Grand Elder's gaze fell upon Chen Ji, his expression complex: 'Chen Ji, you shall remain.' When everyone else had dispersed and only the two of them remained in the hall, the Grand Elder was silent for a long while before speaking: 'Twelve years of patience, a reversal in a single dawn... You are far more than I imagined.'

Chen Ji stood with bowed head, his gray robe appearing particularly thin in the morning light. There was no joy of victory on his face, only a faint weariness. Twelve years of pretending to be worthless, twelve years of patient concealment—today finally drew to a close. Yet this was merely the beginning of an even greater chess game. His gaze swept past the window lattice toward the faintly visible Demon Suppression Tower in the distance—that place would become the Second Elder's prison for the rest of his life.
